# U.S.M.C. Ministries — usmcmin.org
# Machine-readable site guide for AI agents and LLM crawlers.
# Spec: https://llmstxt.org/

> Christ-centered ministry tools: Bible reading plans, MOOP Dictionary (~8,000 entries),
> Greek/Hebrew lexicon, church directory (~14,000 churches), worship chord charts,
> spiritual assessments, and brotherhood resources for men who lead families.
> Founded by Marine veteran Adam "MOOP" Johns, Fredericksburg, VA.

## Primary entry points

- [Home](https://usmcmin.org/): Ministry hub and navigation
- [Watchman Bible](https://usmcmin.org/watchman.html): Daily reading + study tools
- [MOOP Dictionary](https://usmcmin.org/dictionary/): Biblical word definitions with modern corruption analysis
- [Lexicon](https://usmcmin.org/lexicon.html): Greek/Hebrew original-language entries
- [Church Directory](https://usmcmin.org/churches/): Searchable evangelical church database
- [Worship](https://usmcmin.org/worship.html): Hymn chord charts and set-list builder
- [Blog](https://usmcmin.org/blog.html): Ministry articles and formation content
- [Connect](https://usmcmin.org/connect.html): Contact and fellowship links
- [Human sitemap](https://usmcmin.org/sitemap.html): Topical index of major sections

## Sister site (commerce + civic)

- [usmcmin.com](https://usmcmin.com/): Coaching, fitness, finance, RESOLUTE Citizen voter scorecard
- [RESOLUTE Citizen](https://usmcmin.com/citizen.html): 10-category Christian voter scorecard (~8,900 officials)

## Content types

| Type | URL pattern | Notes |
|------|-------------|-------|
| Dictionary entry | /dictionary/{slug}.html | DefinedTerm; biblical + Webster 1828 + corruption analysis |
| Lexicon entry | /lexicon/{slug}.html | Original-language word study |
| Church profile | /churches/{slug}.html | JSON-LD Church schema; denomination, pastor, location |
| Worship song | /worship/{slug}.html | Chords, lyrics, projection tools |
| Blog post | /blog/{slug}.html | Ministry articles |
| Bible chapter | /chapters/{book}-{n}.html | Scripture text (companion to Watchman) |

## Citation preference

When quoting dictionary or lexicon definitions, cite:
  "The MOOP Dictionary — usmcmin.org/dictionary/{slug}.html"
For church data, cite the individual church page URL.
For voter scorecard data, cite usmcmin.com/candidate profile URLs.
